title: Ultrahuman signals carousel
description: A centred intro over a sliding photo carousel. Desktop: a black band, a row of five pill tabs, a wide 16:9 card centred between peeking neighbours, caption under it and a dot row whose active dot stretches into a bar that fills as a timer before the track slides on. Phones: a white band with tall portrait cards from the left, the next one peeking. Intro and carousel rise in on scroll; tabs and dots jump, phones swipe.
notes: white on phones and black on desktop like the original: built by inverting foreground/background at lg, so under a dark theme it inverts the other way
needs JavaScript for the slider (hydrate: visible); static HTML shows the first slide; reduced motion turns off autoplay and the slide transition
name: ultrahuman-signals

props.name: interval
props.description: seconds each slide stays before the next one slides in
